crossRefs.note: You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock…
They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude…
however the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
“Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the…
For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock…

parallels.note: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.
But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Israel took for themselves only the livestock and the goods of that city, according to Yahweh’s word which he commanded Joshua.
translations.bsb: Israel took for themselves only the cattle and plunder of that city, as the LORD had commanded Joshua.
translations.kjv: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.
translations.asv: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for prey unto themselves, according unto the word of Jehovah which he commanded Joshua.
